summary: Babel MAC authentication (RFC 8967) checks packet counters to resist replay attacks, but strict checking can drop legitimate packets that arrive out of order. This document relaxes the verification rules so the protocol copes better with packet reordering. It updates RFC 8967.

eli5.summary: If numbered letters sometimes arrive in the wrong order, a strict clerk throws away good ones. This lets the clerk be a bit more forgiving, while still catching copies.
